method: Two genuine native-window captures showing the empty composer and the exact pasted command. Frames are held for 1.2 and 4.8 seconds. This is a paste demonstration, not an installation recording.
encoding: Animated GIF, 584 by 210, six seconds, plus a static PNG poster. The optional H.264 MP4 uses 15fps, yuv420p and fast start.
notes: Only the composer is included. Sidebar, conversations, account and environment names are excluded.
The website uses a rounded GIF that loops automatically when visible, without playback controls. Reduced-motion readers and readers without JavaScript get the still image.
Visible copyable text provides the same instruction without playback.
